summary.text: Eric Woods is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 18 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Eric Woods earned degrees in political science, history and religious studies from the University of Missouri.
His career experience includes working as a regulatory and compliance manager focused on data privacy and security.

Woods was assigned to the House Transportation Committee for 2025-2026; in 2023-2024 he also served on the Agriculture Policy, Conservation and Natural Resources, and Elections and Elected Officials committees.
